source_description: Curated review of Cirrus model-tournament policy v3, experiment registry, model definitions, and the frozen protocols/results for hybrid-calibration-001 and noon-three-session-tail-001. Original private source files are not included.

cards.title: Calibrated conservative Hybrid
cards.role: Research only · advanced as an inactive candidate
cards.how_it_works: Training-only chronological probability calibration and conservative payoff ranking were compared with unchanged Hybrid and a tight-spread baseline at a one-session horizon.
cards.evaluation_window: Frozen discovery replay dates: 2026-08-18 to 2026-10-02; no confirmation dates. These are dataset bounds, not a claim that all dates produced selections.
cards.population: Historical option quote selections, one-session exit; separate from the actual emailed cohort.
evaluation_summary: 11 selected: 10 mature, 9 resolved, 1 mature missing exit and 1 pending. Resolved coverage: 90% of mature selections.
Candidate stressed mean on 9 resolved selections: +43.94%; mature missing-exit-as-full-loss stressed mean: +29.54%. Unchanged Hybrid: +41.21% and +27.09%, respectively.

Primary paired stressed improvement versus unchanged Hybrid: +2.45 percentage points over 10 identical mature dates, counting missing exits as full losses. Candidate net mean excluding its best resolved trade: +37.42%.
Decision: retain inactive for a separate prospective admission proposal; no production promotion. AUC and F1 were not reported.
limitations: Only three weeks; week-block uncertainty interval unavailable. Largest ticker share: 55.56% of resolved observations, above the production concentration limit.

Entry at archived ask plus $0.65; next-session exit at archived bid less $0.65. Stress raises ask 5% and lowers exit bid 5%. Captured prices lack provider side timestamps/depth and are proxies, not fills.
All frozen dates are discovery, including October dates. Small, reused samples and incomplete historical coverage cannot establish current live performance.
A prospective eligibility date does not mean an inactive candidate collected observations.

cards.title: Noon three-session tail ensemble
cards.how_it_works: The tail ensemble was refitted to three-session labels and compared at the noon entry clock against Hybrid and a tight-spread baseline using the same horizon.
cards.evaluation_window: Frozen discovery replay dates: 2026-08-18 to 2026-10-07; no confirmation dates. These are dataset bounds, not a claim that all dates produced selections.
cards.population: Historical three-session option quote selections; not the actual one-session emailed cohort.
evaluation_summary: 14 selected: 11 mature, 8 resolved, 3 mature missing exits and 3 pending. Resolved coverage: 72.73% of mature selections, below the study’s 80% threshold.
Resolved net mean: +34.00%; resolved median: −58.22%; win rate: 25%. Removing the best resolved trade leaves a −59.88% net mean.
Resolved stressed mean: +21.24%; mature missing-exit-as-full-loss stressed mean: −11.83%. Positive paired improvement versus same-horizon Hybrid did not overcome the failed gates.
Decision: reject under frozen criteria; no retuning or admission. AUC and F1 were not reported.
limitations: Only three weeks; week-block uncertainty interval unavailable. One large winner materially changes the mean.

Entry at archived ask plus $0.65; third-session exit at archived bid less $0.65. Stress raises ask 5% and lowers exit bid 5%; missing mature exits count as full losses and pending selections are excluded.
Captured quotes lack provider side timestamps/depth and are proxies, not fills. Archive gaps limit coverage.
The same-horizon Hybrid comparator was refitted for this study. These results must not be attributed to the current one-session Hybrid or tail-ensemble models.
